function renderHat(){let left=drop.end-Date.now(),expired=left<=0||!drop.open;document.getElementById('dropTitle').textContent='THE VAULT';document.getElementById('dropDesc').textContent='The $2.40 hat is featured in THE VAULT for this timed release.';let timer=document.getElementById('timer');timer.classList.toggle('expired',expired);document.getElementById('timerState').textContent=expired?'● VAULT CLOSED':'● RELEASE WINDOW LIVE';document.getElementById('heroVault').classList.toggle('is-open',!expired);document.getElementById('heroVault').classList.toggle('is-closed',expired);document.getElementById('doorLabel').textContent=expired?'VAULT CLOSED':'VAULT OPEN';document.getElementById('enterDrop').disabled=expired;document.getElementById('enterDrop').style.opacity=expired?'.45':'1';let s=Math.max(0,Math.floor(left/1000));document.getElementById('dd').textContent=String(Math.floor(s/86400)).padStart(2,'0');document.getElementById('hh').textContent=String(Math.floor(s%86400/3600)).padStart(2,'0');document.getElementById('mm').textContent=String(Math.floor(s%3600/60)).padStart(2,'0');document.getElementById('ss').textContent=String(s%60).padStart(2,'0');const capPhoto=document.querySelector('#vault-cap-detail img');const capSrc=capPhoto?capPhoto.getAttribute('src'):'';document.getElementById('hatDisplay').innerHTML=expired?'<div class="empty">THE VAULT IS CLOSED<br><br>This release window has ended. Check back when the owner opens the next drop.</div>':`<div class="vault-featured-cap" style="max-width:420px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center;padding:20px;border:1px solid #716444;background:#111"><img src="${capSrc}" alt="Make Gas $2.40 Again Dad Hat" style="width:100%;max-height:360px;object-fit:contain"><h3 style="margin:12px 0">Make Gas $2.40 Again Dad Hat</h3><p style="color:#d5bc6b">$26.99</p><button type="button" class="btnacid" onclick="document.getElementById('vault-cap-detail').showModal()">VIEW THE $2.40 HAT →</button></div>`}
function renderOwnerItems(){document.getElementById('ownerItems').innerHTML=products.length?products.map(p=>`<div class="owneritem"><div><b>${escapeHtml(p.name)}</b><small>${escapeHtml(brands[p.brand]||'Brand')} · ${money(p.price)}</small></div><button class="danger" onclick="removeProduct(${p.id})">REMOVE</button></div>`).join(''):'<p style="color:#aaa">No items yet.</p>'}
window.removeProduct=function(id){products=products.filter(p=>p.id!==id);save();renderOwnerItems();renderProducts();renderHat();notify('Item removed from display.')};
function showTab(id){document.querySelectorAll('#controlPane .tabs button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===id));['productsTab','dropTab','brandTab'].forEach(x=>document.getElementById(x).classList.toggle('hidden',x!==id));}
document.getElementById('ownerOpen').onclick=()=>document.getElementById('ownerDialog').showModal();document.getElementById('closeDialog').onclick=()=>document.getElementById('ownerDialog').close();
document.getElementById('loginBtn').onclick=()=>{if(document.getElementById('ownerPass').value==='VaultOwner26!'){document.getElementById('loginPane').classList.add('hidden');document.getElementById('controlPane').classList.remove('hidden');renderOwnerItems();renderBrandInputs();showTab('productsTab')}else notify('Passcode not recognized.')};
document.querySelectorAll('.tabs button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>showTab(b.dataset.tab));
document.getElementById('addProduct').onclick=()=>{let name=document.getElementById('pName').value.trim();if(!name){notify('Enter an item name first.');return}products.push({id:Date.now(),name,brand:Number(document.getElementById('pBrand').value),price:Number(document.getElementById('pPrice').value||0),icon:document.getElementById('pIcon').value.trim()||'✦',desc:document.getElementById('pDesc').value.trim()});save();renderOwnerItems();renderProducts();renderHat();['pName','pPrice','pIcon','pDesc'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).value='');notify('Item added to display.')};
document.getElementById('startTimer').onclick=()=>{let n=Math.max(.01,Number(document.getElementById('duration').value||1));let units={hours:3600000,days:86400000,weeks:604800000,months:2592000000};drop={title:document.getElementById('dTitle').value.trim()||'THE VAULT',desc:document.getElementById('dDescription').value.trim(),end:Date.now()+n*units[document.getElementById('durationUnit').value],open:true};save();renderHat();notify('Vault release window opened.')};
document.getElementById('closeVaultNow').onclick=()=>{drop.open=false;drop.end=Date.now();save();renderHat();notify('Vault closed.')};
